datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Mozambique to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Classification data were spatially referenced and compiled into geographic datasets for February, June, and December 2018, representing current situation assessments at specific time periods.
